segments.name: Property Management
segments.description: Provides maintenance and office field talent to property management companies responsible for apartment communities and commercial buildings across the U.S.
segments.evidence: The Property Management segment provides office and maintenance field talent to property management companies responsible for the apartment communities' and commercial buildings' day-to-day operations.

revenueModel.text: Property management companies pay BGSF for contract field talent assignments and contingent direct hire placements.
revenueModel.evidence: Our workforce services consist of on-demand or short-term assignments and direct hire placements in the Property Management industry.

changes.text: In 2025, the Company sold its Professional segment to INSPYR Solutions, leaving Property Management as its only segment.
changes.evidence: This effort resulted in the sale of the Professional segment in September 2025 to INSPYR Solutions.
